title: The practices row placement lookup is the kit IconButton again, so the hand-rolled icon button count is back at its baseline of 3

source.ref: node scripts/check-adoption.mjs on main at 3fa8cf849: handrolled-icon-button 3 -> 4 (+1), the new site practice-placement.tsx from #3121 (LIVE-737, ADR-1698)

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30. MEASURED on main at 3fa8cf849: `node scripts/check-adoption.mjs` read handrolled-icon-button 4 against its baseline of 3 (advisory in CI, but the counts may only fall). The fourth site was PracticePlacementButton, the compass lookup on a practices workspace row missing a Pillar or Sub Focus: #3121 (LIVE-737) grew it to a 24px hit box for WCAG 2.2 target-size by writing `inline-flex h-6 w-6 ... rounded-control` on a raw <button>. WHAT CLOSED IT: the lookup composes IconButton (components/ui/icon-button.tsx), plain variant, with the same accessible name and tooltip (`Suggest a Pillar and Sub Focus for <title>`) and the same onClick. The control is now the kit 32px box (44px on a coarse pointer via tap-target), which still clears target-size, and it picks up the kit focus ring and press state the hand-rolled one lacked. No h-6 override: `cn` is a plain join, so a size className would be settled by stylesheet order. The row View link beside it stays a 24px Link (not in this class). LIVE-737's done probe read the raw <button> className for a 24px box, so it is re-pointed in the same PR (an edit fragment): it now reads the placement lookup as IconButton by its label, refuses a size override below the kit box, and reads the kit base for a 24px-or-larger box with tap-target; it still holds the View link, the icon sizes and the four baselines, and it fails on the hand-rolled button. No baseline was raised; check:adoption reads handrolled-icon-button held at 3.

verify.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import {loadConfig,stripComments,countEntry} from './scripts/check-adoption.mjs';import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';const fail=(m)=>{console.error('HYG-160: '+m);process.exit(1)};const e=loadConfig().entries.find((x)=>x.key==='handrolled-icon-button');if(!e)fail('no handrolled-icon-button adoption entry');if(e.baseline>3)fail('the handrolled-icon-button baseline was raised to '+e.baseline+' (it was 3)');const fs=['app/(main)/admin/content/practices/practice-placement.tsx','app/(main)/admin/content/practices/practices-table.tsx'];const n=countEntry(e,fs.map((p)=>{const s=readFileSync(p,'utf8');return {path:p,text:stripComments(s),source:s}})).count;if(n>0)fail(n+' hand-rolled icon-only button(s) on the practices workspace row, which HYG-160 moved onto IconButton');const P=stripComments(readFileSync(fs[0],'utf8'));if(!/<IconButton\b[^>]*label=\{\x60Suggest a Pillar and Sub Focus for/.test(P))fail('the placement lookup no longer composes IconButton with its accessible name');console.log('HYG-160 ok: baseline '+e.baseline+', 0 hand-rolled icon buttons on the practices row, the placement lookup is IconButton')"
verify.note: In-process (HYG-155): reads the handrolled-icon-button entry with check-adoption.mjs own loadConfig, fails if its baseline was raised past 3, counts the class with countEntry and stripComments over the two practices row files only (0 after the fix, 1 at 3fa8cf849), and requires the placement lookup to compose IconButton with its accessible name. About 80 ms. The whole-corpus ratchet stays in ci.yml and the weekly maintenance sweep.
